content_sections.heading: About MyGov
content_sections.text: MyGov is the citizen engagement platform of the Government of India. It functions as an Independent Business Division under Digital India Corporation, a Section 8 company under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology. Details about MyGov can be seen at https://MyGov.in.

content_sections.heading: MyGov Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Edit and produce engaging short-form and long-form video content for digital and social media platforms. Transform scripts, ideas and raw footage into clear and visually engaging video stories. Handle video editing, basic motion graphics, colour correction and grading, sound design and other post-production requirements. Create platform-native video content suitable for different social media formats and audiences. Use AI-powered tools to support editing, ideation, visual creation, enhancement and other stages of video production. Experiment with emerging AI tools and technologies to improve the quality and efficiency of video workflows. Work closely with content, design, research and creative teams to execute video requirements. Create engaging transitions, graphics, text treatments and other visual elements that strengthen video storytelling. Ensure consistency in visual quality, audio quality, formatting and overall presentation across video outputs. Manage multiple video assignments and deliver content within defined timelines. Stay updated with new editing styles, social media trends, video formats and developments in AI-led content production. Conceptualise, edit and deliver high-quality short-form and long-form video content for digital and social media platforms. Transform scripts, ideas, raw footage and creative briefs into compelling visual stories aligned with communication objectives. Lead end-to-end post-production, including video editing, motion graphics, colour correction and grading, sound design, compositing and visual effects. Create platform-native video content optimised for different formats, audiences and digital platforms. Use AI-powered tools and emerging technologies to improve video production workflows, enhance creative possibilities and accelerate turnaround time. Experiment with generative AI and other emerging video technologies for ideation, visual creation, animation, enhancement and post-production. Develop strong visual treatments, transitions, graphics and storytelling techniques to improve the overall quality and impact of video content. Work closely with content, research, design and creative teams to translate communication requirements into effective video narratives. Maintain high standards of visual consistency, technical quality, accuracy and brand alignment across all video outputs. Manage multiple video projects simultaneously and ensure timely delivery in a fast-paced content environment. Stay updated with evolving video formats, editing styles, social media trends, AI tools and developments in digital content production. Mentor and guide junior video editors, provide creative and technical inputs, and help improve overall team capabilities. Proven experience in social media design, innovative carousel storytelling, campaign design, branding & identity, infographics, digital-first visual systems, and AI-enabled creative workflows. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in MyGov Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies in total, consisting of 1 Junior Video Editor, 2 Video Editor, and 2 Graphic Designer positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Video Editor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be graduates (or postgraduates for senior Video Editor) preferably in film, video production, or communications.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for the Graphic Designer position?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a graduate or postgraduate degree in any discipline, with relevant design experience.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is needed for the Junior Video Editor role?
faq.answer: The Junior Video Editor role requires 0 to 2 years of relevant experience in video editing, post-production, and digital video content creation.

faq.question: Q5. How much experience is required for the Graphic Designer post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Graphic Designer post must have 5 to 10 years of experience in relevant design fields.

faq.question: Q6. Are these posts permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: These positions are initially on a contract basis with a 3-month probation period, followed by a regular contract upon successful completion.

faq.question: Q7. What additional qualifications give an advantage for Graphic Designer applicants?
faq.answer: An MFA, BFA, or certificate course in Graphic Designing, Multimedia, or Video Editing, along with knowledge of AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, provides an added advantage.
